steps.name: Show pizza dough
positives: A plain and empty pizza base or dough is clearly visible. Only answer with [yes] or [no]

steps.name: Add lettuce
positives: Green Lettuce leaves are visible on top of the pizza base. Only answer with [yes] or [no]

steps.name: Add red tomatoes
positives: Do you clearly see Red cherry tomatoes, visible on top of green Lettuce. Only answer with [yes] or [no]

steps.name: Add black olives
positives: At least multiple black olives are visible on top of green Lettuce. Only answer with [yes] or [no]

steps.name: Add exactly 3 parts of pumpkin
positives: Exactly three parts of orange pumpkin are visible on top of an unprepared pizza. Only answer with [yes] or [no]
negatives: exactly 2 parts of orange pumpkin are visible on top of an unprepared pizza. Only answer with [yes] or [no]

steps.name: Add some Jalapeno peppers
positives: At least multiple green jalapeno pepper slices are visible on top of an unprepared pizza. Only answer with [yes] or [no]

steps.name: Add multiple cheddar slices
positives: At least multiple yellow or orange, squared cheddar cheese slices are visible, Only answer with [yes] or [no]
